title: Victorian Poets- Tennyson, Browning, Rossetti

vibeProfile.oneLine: A critical guide to the Victorian poetry of Tennyson, Browning and Rossetti.

summary: A critical study of three towering Victorian poets: Alfred Tennyson, Robert Browning and Dante Gabriel Rossetti, whose work defined the poetry of nineteenth-century England, from Tennyson's grand elegies to Browning's dramatic monologues. Prepared as a student's companion, it offers context and close readings to guide new readers through their language, forms and preoccupations. A helpful scholarly introduction to the age when English poetry grappled with faith, doubt, love and industrial modernity.
whyReadIt: A scholarly guide to Tennyson, Browning and Rossetti, the poets who defined the Victorian age.

funFacts.text: Browning's dramatic monologues, spoken by invented characters, influenced modern poetry deeply.
